name: Dolo 650
dosage: Take only as prescribed by a doctor. Typical adult dose is one tablet every 4-6 hours as directed. Do not exceed the prescribed maximum daily dose.
warnings: Avoid alcohol while using this medicine
storage: Store in a cool and dry place, away from direct sunlight.

faq.question: Can I use Dolo 650 for fever?
faq.answer: Dolo 650 is commonly used for fever and body pain. Follow prescribed dosage and consult a doctor if symptoms continue.

faq.question: Can I take Dolo 650 on an empty stomach?
faq.answer: It can often be taken with or without food, but follow your doctor's advice if you have stomach issues.

name: Crocin Advance
dosage: Take only as prescribed by a doctor.
warnings: Do not combine with other paracetamol products
Not for long-term use without medical advice
storage: Store below 25°C in a dry place.

faq.question: Is Crocin the same as Dolo?
faq.answer: Both contain paracetamol but brand formulations may differ. Always follow your doctor's recommendation.

name: Azithral 500
uses: Bacterial infections as prescribed by a doctor
dosage: Take exactly as prescribed. Complete the full course even if you feel better.
warnings: Not for viral infections like common cold or flu
Inform doctor about liver or heart conditions
storage: Store at room temperature, protect from moisture.

faq.question: Can I stop Azithral when I feel better?
faq.answer: You should complete the prescribed course unless your doctor advises otherwise.

name: Pan 40
dosage: Usually taken once daily before breakfast or as directed by a doctor.
warnings: Long-term use should be supervised by a doctor
Report persistent stomach pain to a doctor
storage: Store in a cool, dry place.

faq.question: When should I take Pan 40?
faq.answer: Typically before breakfast on an empty stomach, but follow your doctor's instructions.

name: Allegra 120
dosage: Take as prescribed by a doctor, usually once daily.
warnings: Avoid fruit juices close to dose time unless advised
Use caution when driving if drowsy
storage: Store at room temperature away from moisture.

faq.question: Does Allegra cause sleepiness?
faq.answer: It is generally non-drowsy, but individual reactions vary. Consult a doctor if concerned.

name: Combiflam
dosage: Take only as prescribed by a doctor. Do not exceed recommended dose.
warnings: Not for everyone – avoid if you have certain stomach, kidney, or heart conditions unless prescribed
Do not combine with other NSAIDs or paracetamol without medical advice
storage: Store in a cool, dry place.

faq.question: Can I take Combiflam for headache?
faq.answer: It may be used for pain and fever when prescribed. Always follow your doctor's guidance.

name: Hifenac 100
uses: Ankylosing spondylitis (as prescribed by a doctor)
dosage: Take only as prescribed by a doctor. Usually taken with or after food to reduce stomach irritation. Do not exceed the prescribed dose or duration.
warnings: Avoid if you have active stomach ulcers or bleeding unless prescribed
Use caution in kidney disease, heart disease, asthma, or pregnancy
Avoid alcohol while taking this medicine unless your doctor approves
storage: Store in a cool, dry place below 25°C. Keep away from children.

faq.question: What are the uses of aceclofenac?
faq.answer: Aceclofenac is commonly used for pain and inflammation related to conditions such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, and ankylosing spondylitis when prescribed by a doctor. It should only be used under medical supervision.

faq.question: Can I take aceclofenac for fever?
faq.answer: It is primarily used for pain and inflammation, not usually as a first choice for fever. Follow your doctor's advice for fever management.
